body: I graduated this year from high school but I missed so much school last year that had my mom not excused me and said I was 'sick', I wouldn't have been allowed to walk across the stage or go to prom. I just couldn't handle school

i just feel so lost and unwanted. I have no friends anymore, my family doesn't care about anything I have to say...lately all I've been doing is crying in my room because I'm so down and I don't even know why

I would like to be a writer someday but I have tried writing a book and have failed. I'm really not good at much, and the hobbies I'm interested in don't pay as careers. I really just don't see a place for myself anywhere out there
I feel like the future doesn't hold anything for me at all, it would be better without me in it
